It's been already one year since we have shifted to the house made by Home Decor,

I would never thought I might have to write a review to make these people realise what kind of professionalism they have showed by accepting this project.

These guys used to really cut short on the manpower which might save their money, but upon making a personal request to increase manpower still it NEVER EVER happened.

Mr. Shubham who handled our project never said NO for any work but always did the work as the way he wanted in the pace he wanted.. He was always concerned about the payment but never thought of the development of the work and was never even seen on the site to check the status of the work.

The basic estimates were giving by Mr. Shubham were so convincing that ANYONE could fall for it but later we realised the estimates were provided for the product which someone will NEVER ACCEPT in their house and ends up buying decent products which technically you will end up paying more..
Mr. Jay was handled the project as a site contractor..
His role was the keep a site under control with day to day requirment for which he was least bothered as he was following the SPECIAL instructions from Mr. Shubham and the result was WORK AT THE SITE WAS TAKING ALL ITS TIME..

We completely understand Payment was done as per milestone achieved but if any delays were caused in the same would result in delays which were completely not accepted and out of our expectations, even after the payment were done, we had to keep a strong follow up to get the work set back on track. LIKE HAVE TO BEG FOR IT !!

Ms Kesar was our Interior designer from their team, she was so decided and enthusiastic for her work that once the project was completely she didn't even bother to check the site or show a visit to see how things have settled up post completion of the project, she was completely clueless with her designs as she was planning to Paint whole house in White colour and all white interior even though we had asked for a colourful combinations, she was clueless on space saving concept which might have resulted our living room to look absolutely conjugated, BUT LUCKILY WE DIDN'T LET THAT HAPPENED, At the end majority of the colour combination and space saving concept come out of our side rather then she showing her expertise..

Mr. Yadava who is owner of this company was clueless during the meeting which was held for the selection of laminates, he was least bothered to know the budget and ended up wasting time by more than and hour by showing most expensive laminates..

After the completion of the project as promised for the Deep cleaning with so much of technicalities explained for the same the output was phtetic for the proof I have attached some pictures with this review, so have to asked them to get the cleaning done again..

Once the project is handled over this guys were least bothered to know the difficulties we faced as they were just intrested and focused on the photoshoot to show world how superior they are..

Till date I still haven't got my pending works done as they wanted to get the photoshoot of the project.

Finally we decided to post a review and share the experience around so that people around take a wise decision to interact with them..

I wished someone could had shared their REAL experience to us before we handed our project to them....

I have attached few pictures in which you the quality of the work is observed.
-They way paint is getting pealed off.
-The way ceiling wallpaper getting damaged even after changing it with the previous worst fitting.
- False ceiling work has already developed major cracks.

Pictures says it all !!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Mr. Jeraj,

If you read your own review, you will clearly see that at multiple points you have yourself accepted your own mistakes, faults, and lack of commitment, including admitting delay in payments, which is where these issues actually originated.

We must state this at the very beginning: despite accepting your own mistakes, you chose to blackmail us.

You repeatedly gave us false assurances of the mandatory photoshoot (as per Clause 6.13 of the agreement) that it would be permitted later. This behaviour was repeated 2–3 times, and it severely demoralised our entire team.

Instead of discussing the issue with us, you chose to leave a negative review on our page. Technically, according to the agreement, you are legally bound to give us a photoshoot.

On payment delays and work stoppage:
You have clearly admitted delayed payments in your own review. As per Clause 5.5 of the mutually signed agreement,
“Failure of mutually agreed payment slabs and non-payment will result in delay of the work, stoppage of work and could lead to termination of the agreement.”
The delay and stoppage of work were therefore a direct contractual consequence of your own actions, not a failure from our end.

On after-sales services and inspections:
“As per Clause 7.1, all after-sales services require inspection by the Consultant’s operations representative and do not include routine maintenance such as fused bulbs, minor stains, tap leakages due to normal wear and tear. The normal wear-and-tear period is 365 days.”

But still, just to get some minor changes implemented, we sent our person to your site. For such small services, we continued to send our team purely out of goodwill.

On seepage shown in your images:
The seepage visible in the photos attached by you is a society and builder issue, which was clearly identified and warned to you before starting the project. This was never an interior defect.
We could have helped get this resolved as an after-sales support, but breach of contract did not allow us to proceed further.

On photoshoot and contractual breach:
As per Clause 6.13,
“CONSULTANT shall be permitted to use photographs of the CLIENT’s property for its own marketing purposes.”
Despite repeated commitments, you refused the photoshoot and instead insisted that after-sales services be done first.

Despite this, you repeatedly refused the photoshoot and instead resorted to blackmail, insisting that after-sales services be carried out first on false assurances that the photoshoot would be permitted later. On the basis of these assurances, we still extended after-sales support 2–3 times purely as a goodwill gesture, even though this was completely outside our contractual obligation.

We would also like to make it clear here that we are insisting on the photoshoot time and again, because it proves that we have conceptualised your home meticulously and so beautifully and we would want to showcase it to the world.

We provide lifetime warranty on our interiors. Even after continuous blackmail and demoralisation, we are still standing on one leg and stating on a public platform that if you face any major genuine issue with your interiors, we are still ready to provide after-sales support.

Please contact Shubham as per your convenience if you are facing any major genuine issue. We are happy to be of guidance.

Your own review already reflects where the responsibility truly lies.
